title: Rental Plus Upgrades: Utility Line Plan Bundle Credit
content:
**Credit rule.** A Rental Property Service Contracts Plus upgrade charge carries a line-plan bundle credit read from the landlord's Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans holdings.

| Active utility line protection plan held by the landlord | Premium payments posted on the landlord's line plans in the 12 months before the upgrade | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 12 or more | 0.05 |
| yes | 6 to 11 | 0.03 |
| yes | fewer than 6 | 0 |
| no | any | 0 |

**Records read.** From the Utility Line Protection Plans records: the landlord's line plans and their status, and the premium payments posted in the line plans' billing history, with their dates.

**How the credit acts.** Credits on a Plus upgrade charge are subtracted from one and a loading is added to it, all in one sum, and the charge is multiplied once by that sum before its single rounding to the cent.

*Hypothetical:* an active line plan with 11 payments posted in the 12 months: 0.03; with 5: no credit.
